Summary

Under the supervision of the Public Policy Manager, the Digital Equity Program Coordinator will support the Digital Equity and Navigation Programs of El Concilio of San Mateo County (ECSMC), leading the New Voices for Youth Program and ¡Conectémonos! These programs connect community members and youth with digital resources and build technology and digital literacy across our communities. New Voices for Youth supports students from underserved communities in using video and other digital tools for advocacy. Meeting at afterschool centers, students choose topics, practice interviews, and create and edit digital narratives. The program has historically taken place twice a week in North Fair Oaks at the Siena Youth Center (SYC), and in East Palo Alto at the Boys and Girls Club (BGCP).

¡Conectémonos! supports and guides local community members in navigating technology and building digital literacy, with the help of high school volunteers. The program currently takes place at the North Fair Oaks Library three days a week, with plans to expand to additional locations.

Lead and coordinate the Digital Equity and Navigation programs and initiatives
Administer and facilitate workshops and trainings across both programs

Recruit youth from local after-school centers and support their participation in the New Voices for Youth
Mentor, train, and provide ongoing support to high school volunteers
Foster a supportive, inclusive learning environment for youth and adult learners
Maintain accurate program data and assist with reports and data entry
Serve as a liaison between ECSMC, working groups/subcommittees, including conducting presentations as needed
Manage ongoing relationships with the North Fair Oaks Library, afterschool programs, and school sites

Conduct outreach as needed for Conectemonos program

Bachelor’s degree, or 2 years of experience working in technology education, community training, digital literacy programs, or in a similar field

jobs.description:
Program Coordinator – Athletics

Full-Time | Youth Sports, Athletics & Program Development

Help Shape the Future of Youth Athletics at Legarza Sports

Since 1989
, Legarza Sports has been helping young people grow through sports. What began as a basketball camp has grown into a wide range of youth programs throughout the Bay Area, including PE, after-school enrichment, camps, leagues, and school-based athletics.
We’re hiring a Program Coordinator – Athletics
to support our growing programs, with a particular focus on our Middle School Athletic Director (AD) program
.

This is a dynamic, hands-on position for someone who loves sports, enjoys working with kids, and wants to build a career in youth sports, athletic administration, and program leadership
.
The right candidate will be comfortable wearing multiple hats. Some days you may be coaching PE, other days you may be subbing or providing program coverage, and others may be focused on Middle School Athletics, scheduling, staffing, school communication, or other operational priorities.

About the Role

This is a hybrid coaching, athletics, and program coordination role
.
You’ll begin by learning Legarza’s philosophies, systems, and teaching methods while working directly within our programs. You’ll coach and support PE and after-school programs while also helping coordinate the many moving pieces behind our Middle School Athletic Director programs.

The position is intentionally broad. We’re looking for someone who can step in where needed, solve problems, take ownership, and help programs run successfully.

As you grow in the role, you’ll have opportunities to take on increased responsibility for athletic programming, school partnerships, staff development, operations, and program growth.

What You’ll Do

Support Legarza’s Middle School Athletic Director programs, helping coordinate teams, coaches, practices, games, schedules, staffing, and seasonal logistics.
Serve as a key point of support for coaches, school administrators, families, and program partners, helping ensure programs are organized, communicated clearly, and run successfully.
Spend some days coaching PE programs and other days subbing and providing coverage where needed, while also leading and supporting after-school sports and enrichment programs.
Coach and support additional Legarza programs as needed, including camps, leagues, special events, and other company programs.
Support the recruitment, onboarding, and development of coaches while helping maintain consistent expectations and standards across programs.
Work closely with Legarza leadership to improve operations, solve day-to-day challenges, strengthen school partnerships, and identify opportunities to grow and expand our athletics programming.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is adaptable, organized, dependable, and ready to take ownership. You don’t need to have already been an Athletic Director or Program Manager—we’re looking for someone with the right foundation who wants to learn and grow.

Required

Experience playing, coaching, and/or working in sports

Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt when plans change
Willingness to coach, substitute, and step into different programs based on company needs
Ability to take initiative and follow through on responsibilities and deadlines
High energy, reliability, professionalism, and a team-first mentality
Desire to learn, take feedback, and grow into greater responsibility

Preferred — Not Required

Experience coaching or playing multiple sports
Experience working in a school or youth sports environment
Experience coordinating teams, leagues, schedules, or athletic programs
Experience communicating with parents, coaches, and school administrators
Interest in athletic administration and program development
Long-term interest in youth sports leadership and management

If you don’t meet every qualification but are excited about the opportunity and believe you can grow into the role, we still encourage you to apply.

Starting pay: $25–$26/hour

Clear opportunities for advancement as our programs grow
Opportunity to take on increasing ownership within our Middle School Athletics program
Long-term leadership opportunities for strong performers
Compensation growth based on responsibility, performance, and impact

Mission-driven organization focused on leadership, character, and excellence
More than 35 years of experience in Bay Area youth sports

Hands-on exposure to both coaching and sports administration

Opportunity to take on greater ownership and responsibility as you grow
Real opportunity to build a long-term career in youth sports

Apply today and help us deliver outstanding sports experiences for students, families, and schools throughout the Bay Area.

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The Research Data Analyst (RDA) will support the Principal Investigator in a broad scope of research-related activities taking place in the United States The RDA will plan, coordinate, and oversee data systems for research studies i.e. database set-up, data management, developing and pilot-testing questionnaires, conducting quality assurance, preparing recruitment reports, overseeing system for data queries, and monitoring study retention. The RDA will function as a liaison between site data managers/programmers for the purposes of database creation and management, and will plan and coordinate weekly or semi-weekly meetings among data staff to regulatory track progress and troubleshoot issues. This position involves working with a variety of UCSF and non-UCSF faculty and staff to complete data entry and securely transfer data to approved academic partners. Study databases will be created and maintained in the UCSF secure research environment using RED-CAP. The RDA will oversee data entry, data management and storage, develop programming to generate weekly progress and monitoring reports, conduct data management and quality assurance, and provide technical assistance to research staff related to data entry and processing. The RDA will be responsible for using standard privacy and compliance procedures for the safe handling and use of electronic medical record and public health surveillance data for research purposes. The RDA may at times be required to conduct medical record chart reviews for completion of data elements and/or to assure data integrity.

The incumbent will also develop tables, graphs, and contribute to analyses for reports and publications under the direction of the study PIs and study statistician; and perform other data management/department tasks as assigned to meet the overall data and technical needs of the program.

This position requires the RDA work in the office a minimum of 4 days/week.

ABOUT THE DIVISION OF HIV, INFECTIOUS DISEASES AND GLOBAL MEDICINE

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) is an internationally recognized global leader in clinical care, research, and education. With its home-base located at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG), the Division has been ranked as the top facility in the country for AIDS care since 1983. The Division’s work is featured frequently in the media, and it is often visited by numerous international, national, state, and local dignitaries and delegations. The Division consists of approximately 36 faculty members, 11 fellows/postdoctoral scholars and 170 academic and staff employees. It is the largest Division of the Department of Medicine (DOM) at ZSFG, with a total expenditure budget of approximately $52 million dollars.

Demonstrated ability to interact effectively with a wide range of team members, including faculty investigators, programmers, community partners, and other data managers from diverse cultural backgrounds
Ability to communicate clearly and succinctly in spoken and written English

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

AI transformed digital industries. Progress in physical sciences stalled: drug discovery, materials science, climate modeling. The bottleneck isn't compute or algorithms. It's data. The best scientific datasets sit locked away.

Harell Data fixes this. Organizations share proprietary datasets securely, train models on high-performance GPUs, and deploy them for inference. Data owners keep their data. Model creators keep their models. Both have an opportunity to earn from their contributions.

Our founding datasets are the ones the field cannot get anywhere else. How antibodies latch onto their targets, across millions of pairs. How T-cell receptors recognize what to target, across whole populations. Real measurements at a scale no public source can match.

About the Role

You'll be our first Solutions Engineer. Your job: make customers succeed, from their first training job to a production model.

Our customers are computational scientists, bioinformaticians, and ML engineers working the hardest problems in drug discovery and protein modeling. You connect what they need to what our platform does.

This role is for someone who already understands this science and loves the craft of making a model better. You will spend your days inside training runs and binding data, collaborating with scientists and engineers across biotech, pharma, and academia. The work is deep. The problems are real.

What You Will Do

Get customers to their first result.
Help customers move their datasets onto the platform. Shrink time to first training job with getting-started guides, sample notebooks, and self-serve paths.
Make stuck models move.
This is the heart of the job. A customer's training run is failing, or slow, or stalling on a novel target. You find why. You debug PyTorch and Hugging Face configs, clear pipeline blockages, tune GPU workloads, and guide training code onto new GPU hardware.
Speak to the data with authority.
A customer asks what our antibody-antigen or TCR-pMHC datasets can do for their model. You answer. You know which dataset fits which problem, and why real binding measurements beat public data on hard targets.
Shape what gets built.
Turn the hurdles and requests you see into signal for engineering. Help decide what to build and what to buy. What you learn from customers steers the roadmap.

Qualifications

You understand this science.
Protein, antibody, or immune-repertoire ML. You know what binding, affinity, and specificity mean, and why a model trained on public data fails on novel targets. You can hold your own in a room full of researchers on day one. A degree is not the point. Understanding is.
You can read and debug ML training code.
Real PyTorch and Hugging Face code. Building and fixing the model run itself, not summarizing an error log with an AI tool.
5+ years
being the technical person people seek out to make hard things clear. Time spent briefing partners, guiding collaborators, fielding the hard questions, or owning the customer conversation. Deep technical skill, and the gift for explaining it to people inside and outside your field.
Cloud and HPC fundamentals.
AWS or GCP, Linux, containers, and hands-on time training models on GPUs. You understand how infrastructure choices shape a training run. That is what lets you help a customer whose job is slow, stuck, or scaling badly.
Strong communication.
Clear written skills for technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides.
Startup comfort.
You write the first draft of missing documentation and build the initial demo. Ambiguity does not stall you.

Bonus Points

You have gotten training code running on a new generation of GPU hardware.
You have worked somewhere nothing was built yet, and you built it.

Location note: this role is based in Bellevue, WA. No relocation assistance available for the role.

Job Summary

This role reports to the Director of Data & Business Analytics as a key member of the TransTech Data & Analytics team, working directly with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain and IT leadership across all business units and with our ERP implementation partners.

TransTech is consolidating the separate ERP systems of its business units onto a single enterprise platform (IFS Cloud), and data readiness is the single largest determinant of whether that program succeeds. The Data Analyst will be the hands-on data lead for the implementation: owning the extraction, profiling, cleansing, mapping, transformation, mock loading and reconciliation of legacy master and transactional data into IFS, and driving business owners to sign off on data they will live with for the next decade.

Following go-live, the role becomes the permanent owner of enterprise master data governance (Item, Customer, Vendor and related domains) and of the data engineering pipelines that bring ERP data into TransTech’s Microsoft Fabric platform and Power BI reporting. The intended growth path is from ERP data lead into a Senior or Lead Data Engineer or Data Architect role within Data & Analytics, with leadership opportunities also open in ERP and Business Systems, Finance, or Operations.

The ideal candidate has been through at least one full ERP implementation as the person responsible for the data, understands manufacturing and fabrication data end to end (items, BOMs, routings, customers, vendors, inventory, open orders, GL), and combines rigorous attention to detail with the credibility to challenge business owners and the pragmatism to get to a decision. They are equally at home in a modern data engineering toolset: repeatable pipelines and notebooks, Git, an agile backlog, and AI assistants used to move faster without compromising accuracy.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

ERP Data Migration & Readiness:

Serve as TransTech’s data lead for the ERP implementation, owning the data workstream plan, deliverables and readiness gates with the implementation partner and program management.
Extract and profile master and transactional data from legacy systems (SYSPRO, Syteline/CloudSuite Industrial and others), quantifying volumes, completeness, duplication and quality issues by domain.
Build and maintain source-to-target mapping and transformation specifications for each data object (Item/Part, BOM, Routing, Customer, Vendor, Chart of Accounts, Inventory, Open AR/AP, Open Sales and Purchase Orders, Fixed Assets, Employees) against the IFS Cloud data model and load templates.
Design and execute cleansing, de-duplication, standardization and enrichment routines in SQL, Python and Fabric notebooks; track defects to closure with business data owners.
Prepare and execute mock loads, cutover rehearsals and the production cutover; reconcile counts, quantities and financial values to source; run business validation and sign-off; and maintain the data issue log, decision log and cutover checklist.
Support data-related integration requirements between IFS Cloud and surrounding systems (OneStream, Salesforce, Procore, Smartsheet, Fabric).

Master Data Governance

Lead harmonization of Item, Customer and Vendor master data across business units (numbering and naming standards, required attributes, hierarchies, cross-references) and facilitate the cross-BU decisions needed to converge on one standard.
Establish and operate the post-go-live governance model: data ownership and stewardship roles, create/change/retire workflows, approval controls and standards documentation.
Define, measure and publish data quality KPIs by domain and business unit, drive remediation, and act as the enterprise escalation point for master data questions.

Data Engineering & Analytics

Design, build and operate the pipelines that land source-system data in Microsoft Fabric (mirroring, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows, PySpark/SQL notebooks) across Bronze, Silver and Gold layers, including incremental loads, orchestration, monitoring and automated data quality checks.
Build the ERP extracts and Silver/Gold models that replace legacy business-unit reporting after go-live, ensuring continuity of executive and operational Power BI reporting through cutover, and validate that reported figures reconcile to the ERP.
Automate recurring data preparation, validation and reconciliation with SQL, Python/PySpark and Power Query, replacing manual and spreadsheet-based processes with tested, scheduled code.
Apply software engineering practices to data work: Git-based version control in Azure DevOps, pull requests and code review, dev/test/prod promotion, and documentation as code.

Ways Of Working, Training & Documentation

Work within the team’s agile delivery model (user stories, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives in Azure DevOps), breaking migration and governance work into estimable, demonstrable increments.
Use AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, AI-assisted coding) as a routine part of profiling, code generation, documentation and analysis, with sound judgment about validating outputs before they are relied on.
Develop and maintain data standards, data dictionaries, mapping documents, runbooks and end-user guides; train and coach business data owners, stewards and analysts; and mentor other members of the Data & Analytics team.

Education And/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Accounting/Finance, Supply Chain or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Five or more years of progressive data analysis, data management or business systems experience in a manufacturing, fabrication, engineered-equipment or industrial services environment.
Hands-on ownership of the data workstream on at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation or migration, including extraction, cleansing, mapping, mock loads, reconciliation and cutover (required).
Strong working knowledge of ERP data structures across manufacturing, supply chain and finance: item/part master, BOMs and routings, customer ship-to/bill-to structures, vendors, inventory and lot/serial data, open orders and GL/sub-ledger balances.
Advanced SQL and Excel required; Python/PySpark and Power Query strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience building data pipelines and lakehouse or warehouse models on Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks or a comparable platform; medallion architecture and Power BI familiarity preferred.
IFS Cloud experience strongly preferred; SYSPRO, Infor Syteline/CloudSuite Industrial, or Infor Visual experience also relevant.
Master data management or data governance experience, and experience consolidating multiple entities, sites or acquired businesses onto a common platform, preferred.
Working knowledge of Git and Azure DevOps (or GitHub/Jira), experience on an agile/scrum team, and demonstrated use of AI assistants in day-to-day analytical and engineering work, preferred.

Personal Attributes

Highest level of integrity and ethics.
Exceptional attention to detail; Strong use of validation to source systems is a must.
Comfortable owning outcomes in an ambiguous, fast-moving program environment with firm deadlines.
Forges strong cross-functional partnerships and drives business owners to timely decisions.

is pleased to announce an excellent career opportunity for a Pickleball Program Coordinator

Welcome to Entrada at Snow Canyon Country Club, an exclusive, members-only full-service private club in beautiful St. George, Utah, where only the best food, finest cocktails and superior service is delivered among an amazing championship golf course, a resort-inspired pool, and state of the art fitness center. Joining our team not only provides you with unparalleled career opportunities, but it is also the place where you will connect and be surrounded by other talented hospitality professionals like yourself, working together to create memorable experiences for our members and their guests. The atmosphere is refined, the music is lively, and the comradery is personal – there’s nowhere else you’d rather be.

Our Pickleball Program Coordinator provides leadership to an important function that creates and executes a growing and dynamic pickleball program to our members, prospective members and guests. Under the leadership of the Director of Fitness, this role promotes high-level hospitality to members and their guests and organizes and implements all racquet activities with the goal of enhancing the image and member experience of Entrada at Snow Canyon Country Club.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Create a welcoming, energetic atmosphere through high-quality pickleball open play, leagues, social events, and tournaments for players of all skill levels.
Foster engagement, build community, and promote participation while supporting daily court operations and delivering outstanding hospitality.
Responsible for the programming of all racquet activities.
Responsible for administering all areas and functions of the tennis and pickleball programs, including social events, classes, clinics, lessons, training, special events, and tournaments.
Executes all daily operations of the Club’s racquet program, including opening and closing procedures.
Assist members with court reservations, lesson registrations, and program inquiries.
Responsible for implementing and maintaining excellent racquet service and managing member relationships to achieve exceptional member satisfaction.
Perform necessary administrative tasks, such as attendance taking, returning messages, and general correspondence with patrons and co-workers.
Success will be measured by program growth, member and guest satisfaction, and the creation of a fun, active pickleball culture that enhances the club experience.
Responsible for managing the proper care, maintenance and cleanliness of outdoor courts and related equipment.
Works with members, Wellness Committee and Director of Fitness to implement and adjust policies and procedures.
Responsible for evaluating performance of racquet programs and addressing complaints and resolving problems.
Coordinate effectively with department team members that may include teaching professionals, front desk, weekend supervisor, fitness trainers / instructors and spa therapists.
Work with other departments to achieve member service and communication objectives regarding club activities and events.
Respond to time-sensitive matters including member queries and incident responses.
Maintain strictest of confidence in sensitive matters pertaining to members and/or associates. Privy to information that is not to be shared.
Effective team member offering solutions and suggestions to membership complaints, issues, facility challenges and overall ways to better enhance service, a hospitality culture and the overall Club culture.
Able to utilize rational judgment and discretion to ensure members' overall satisfaction with no or minimum supervision in day-to-day operations.
Uses diplomacy whenever interacting or handling complaints from members.
Ensure online calendars, bulletin boards, and/or other communication means are kept up to date.
Promote and support racquet social events, lessons, clinics, leagues, camps, and tournaments.
Enforce guest policies and support Wellness Center programming.
Performs other duties as required and self-initiated as part of the team culture.
Flexible availability including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Regular and reliable attendance.
Professional appearance and demeanor suitable for a private club environment.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

Associate’s degree (AA) in Physical Education or related field; or six months to one year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Frequently talks and hears. Frequently uses hands; reaches with hands and arms; talks, hears, stands and walks, climbs or balances; stoops, and kneels. Occasionally sits, crouches, or crawls; tastes or smells. Occasionally lifts up to 45 pounds.

ENVIRONMENT/NOISE:

Occasionally works in outdoor weather conditions. Noise level is moderate.

CERTIFICATES/LICENSES:

USAPA certification (or equivalent). AED, CPR and First Aid.

JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILL, AND ABILITY PREFERENCES:

Ability to read and speak English may be required in order to perform the duties of the job (e.g. the associate may be required to communicate with English speaking customers or co-workers, the manuals for the equipment the associate may use are in English).
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Products (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word).
Driven individual who is eager to learn, contribute, and grow within a fast paced hospitality-focused property organization.
Service driven, highly organized, knowledgeable in racquet sports, and thrives in a private club setting.
Outstanding communication skills – written and verbal – are required to interact with members, senior leadership, other departments, outside agencies/vendors and colleagues.
Independent thinker with outstanding time management skills –ability to manage priorities and schedules that change on a daily basis.
Strong communication skills and proficient knowledge of company policies and procedures.
Available for evenings, weekends and holidays as needed.
Friendly and outgoing, shows a passion for pickleball.
Strong organizational skills: time management, attention to detail, ability to self-start. Strong work ethic.

Summary

Under the supervision of the Public Policy Manager, the Digital Equity Program Coordinator will support the Digital Equity and Navigation Programs of El Concilio of San Mateo County (ECSMC), leading the New Voices for Youth Program and ¡Conectémonos! These programs connect community members and youth with digital resources and build technology and digital literacy across our communities. The Coordinator will also provide ongoing technology education, training, and support for ECSMC programs, staff, volunteers, and promotores.

About the Digital Equity and Navigation Programs

New Voices for Youth supports students from underserved communities in using video and other digital tools for advocacy. Meeting at afterschool centers, students choose topics, practice interviews, and create and edit digital narratives. The program has historically taken place twice a week in North Fair Oaks at the Siena Youth Center (SYC), and in East Palo Alto at the Boys and Girls Club (BGCP).

¡Conectémonos! supports and guides local community members in navigating technology and building digital literacy, with the help of high school volunteers. The program currently takes place at the North Fair Oaks Library three days a week, with plans to expand to additional locations.

Tasks Include:

Lead and coordinate the Digital Equity and Navigation programs and initiatives
Administer and facilitate workshops and trainings across both programs
Develop workshop content for the Conectemonos program
Teach video filming and editing or other techniques, both online and in person
Work with local after-school programs and providers to establish partnerships
Recruit youth from local after-school centers and support their participation in the New Voices for Youth
Mentor, train, and provide ongoing support to high school volunteers
Foster a supportive, inclusive learning environment for youth and adult learners
Maintain accurate program data and assist with reports and data entry
Serve as a liaison between ECSMC, working groups/subcommittees, including conducting presentations as needed
Manage ongoing relationships with the North Fair Oaks Library, afterschool programs, and school sites
Provide technology support to ECSMC Programs as needed
Conduct outreach as needed for Conectemonos program
Support the communications team as needed
Perform additional administrative tasks as needed

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree, or 2 years of experience working in technology education, community training, digital literacy programs, or in a similar field
English proficiency required; bilingual (Spanish) preferred
Commitment to supporting the agency’s overall mission and vision
Ability to exercise good judgment, tact, and diplomacy when interacting with clients, guests, volunteers, and coworkers
Demonstrated record of good attendance and punctuality

programming takes place in the evening, and some weekend work is required.

administration may be done remotely.

Program Coordinator – Athletics

Full-Time | Youth Sports, Athletics & Program Development

Help Shape the Future of Youth Athletics at Legarza Sports

Since 1989
, Legarza Sports has been helping young people grow through sports. What began as a basketball camp has grown into a wide range of youth programs throughout the Bay Area, including PE, after-school enrichment, camps, leagues, and school-based athletics.
We’re hiring a Program Coordinator – Athletics
to support our growing programs, with a particular focus on our Middle School Athletic Director (AD) program
.

This is a dynamic, hands-on position for someone who loves sports, enjoys working with kids, and wants to build a career in youth sports, athletic administration, and program leadership
.
The right candidate will be comfortable wearing multiple hats. Some days you may be coaching PE, other days you may be subbing or providing program coverage, and others may be focused on Middle School Athletics, scheduling, staffing, school communication, or other operational priorities.

About the Role

This is a hybrid coaching, athletics, and program coordination role
.
You’ll begin by learning Legarza’s philosophies, systems, and teaching methods while working directly within our programs. You’ll coach and support PE and after-school programs while also helping coordinate the many moving pieces behind our Middle School Athletic Director programs.

The position is intentionally broad. We’re looking for someone who can step in where needed, solve problems, take ownership, and help programs run successfully.

As you grow in the role, you’ll have opportunities to take on increased responsibility for athletic programming, school partnerships, staff development, operations, and program growth.

What You’ll Do

Support Legarza’s Middle School Athletic Director programs, helping coordinate teams, coaches, practices, games, schedules, staffing, and seasonal logistics.
Serve as a key point of support for coaches, school administrators, families, and program partners, helping ensure programs are organized, communicated clearly, and run successfully.
Spend some days coaching PE programs and other days subbing and providing coverage where needed, while also leading and supporting after-school sports and enrichment programs.
Coach and support additional Legarza programs as needed, including camps, leagues, special events, and other company programs.
Support the recruitment, onboarding, and development of coaches while helping maintain consistent expectations and standards across programs.
Work closely with Legarza leadership to improve operations, solve day-to-day challenges, strengthen school partnerships, and identify opportunities to grow and expand our athletics programming.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is adaptable, organized, dependable, and ready to take ownership. You don’t need to have already been an Athletic Director or Program Manager—we’re looking for someone with the right foundation who wants to learn and grow.

Required

Experience playing, coaching, and/or working in sports
Passion for youth development and working with children
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt when plans change
Willingness to coach, substitute, and step into different programs based on company needs
Ability to take initiative and follow through on responsibilities and deadlines
High energy, reliability, professionalism, and a team-first mentality
Desire to learn, take feedback, and grow into greater responsibility

Preferred — Not Required

Experience coaching or playing multiple sports
Experience working in a school or youth sports environment
Experience coordinating teams, leagues, schedules, or athletic programs
Experience communicating with parents, coaches, and school administrators
Interest in athletic administration and program development
Long-term interest in youth sports leadership and management

If you don’t meet every qualification but are excited about the opportunity and believe you can grow into the role, we still encourage you to apply.

Compensation & Growth

Starting pay: $25–$26/hour

Clear opportunities for advancement as our programs grow
Opportunity to take on increasing ownership within our Middle School Athletics program
Long-term leadership opportunities for strong performers
Compensation growth based on responsibility, performance, and impact
Medical, dental, and vision benefits for eligible employees

401(k)

This position is designed for someone who wants more than a traditional coaching role. You’ll gain hands-on experience across coaching, athletic administration, staffing, school partnerships, and program operations, providing a strong foundation for future leadership opportunities within Legarza.

Hands-on exposure to both coaching and sports administration

Real opportunity to build a long-term career in youth sports

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The Research Data Analyst (RDA) will support the Principal Investigator in a broad scope of research-related activities taking place in the United States The RDA will plan, coordinate, and oversee data systems for research studies i.e. database set-up, data management, developing and pilot-testing questionnaires, conducting quality assurance, preparing recruitment reports, overseeing system for data queries, and monitoring study retention. The RDA will function as a liaison between site data managers/programmers for the purposes of database creation and management, and will plan and coordinate weekly or semi-weekly meetings among data staff to regulatory track progress and troubleshoot issues. This position involves working with a variety of UCSF and non-UCSF faculty and staff to complete data entry and securely transfer data to approved academic partners. Study databases will be created and maintained in the UCSF secure research environment using RED-CAP. The RDA will oversee data entry, data management and storage, develop programming to generate weekly progress and monitoring reports, conduct data management and quality assurance, and provide technical assistance to research staff related to data entry and processing. AI transformed digital industries. Progress in physical sciences stalled: drug discovery, materials science, climate modeling. The bottleneck isn't compute or algorithms. It's data. The best scientific datasets sit locked away.

Harell Data fixes this. Organizations share proprietary datasets securely, train models on high-performance GPUs, and deploy them for inference. Data owners keep their data. Model creators keep their models. Both have an opportunity to earn from their contributions.

Our founding datasets are the ones the field cannot get anywhere else. How antibodies latch onto their targets, across millions of pairs. How T-cell receptors recognize what to target, across whole populations. Real measurements at a scale no public source can match.

About the Role

You'll be our first Solutions Engineer. Your job: make customers succeed, from their first training job to a production model.

Our customers are computational scientists, bioinformaticians, and ML engineers working the hardest problems in drug discovery and protein modeling. You connect what they need to what our platform does.

This role is for someone who already understands this science and loves the craft of making a model better. You will spend your days inside training runs and binding data, collaborating with scientists and engineers across biotech, pharma, and academia. The work is deep. The problems are real.

What You Will Do

Get customers to their first result.
Help customers move their datasets onto the platform. Shrink time to first training job with getting-started guides, sample notebooks, and self-serve paths.
Make stuck models move.
This is the heart of the job. A customer's training run is failing, or slow, or stalling on a novel target. You find why. You debug PyTorch and Hugging Face configs, clear pipeline blockages, tune GPU workloads, and guide training code onto new GPU hardware.
Speak to the data with authority.
A customer asks what our antibody-antigen or TCR-pMHC datasets can do for their model. You answer. You know which dataset fits which problem, and why real binding measurements beat public data on hard targets.
Shape what gets built.
Turn the hurdles and requests you see into signal for engineering. Help decide what to build and what to buy. What you learn from customers steers the roadmap.

You understand this science.

Real PyTorch and Hugging Face code. Building and fixing the model run itself, not summarizing an error log with an AI tool.
5+ years
being the technical person people seek out to make hard things clear. Time spent briefing partners, guiding collaborators, fielding the hard questions, or owning the customer conversation. Deep technical skill, and the gift for explaining it to people inside and outside your field.

Strong communication.
Clear written skills for technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides.
Startup comfort.
You write the first draft of missing documentation and build the initial demo. Ambiguity does not stall you.

You have gotten training code running on a new generation of GPU hardware.
You have worked somewhere nothing was built yet, and you built it.

Experience working in an Agile environment is a plus

Position Title

Data Analyst – ERP & Master Data

Director of Data & Business Analytics

Company Overview

TransTech provides custom-engineered and fabricated solutions for liquids and gas processing, storage, TransTech is a leading provider of specialized infrastructure and custom-engineered equipment for diverse industries. From individual services to full project solutions, TransTech’s teams deliver expert engineering, fabrication, construction, operations and maintenance, supporting projects nationally and internationally. We help customers achieve impactful, sustainable results with a commitment to safety, community, and environmental responsibility.

Job Summary

This role reports to the Director of Data & Business Analytics as a key member of the TransTech Data & Analytics team, working directly with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain and IT leadership across all business units and with our ERP implementation partners.

TransTech is consolidating the separate ERP systems of its business units onto a single enterprise platform (IFS Cloud), and data readiness is the single largest determinant of whether that program succeeds. The Data Analyst will be the hands-on data lead for the implementation: owning the extraction, profiling, cleansing, mapping, transformation, mock loading and reconciliation of legacy master and transactional data into IFS, and driving business owners to sign off on data they will live with for the next decade.

Following go-live, the role becomes the permanent owner of enterprise master data governance (Item, Customer, Vendor and related domains) and of the data engineering pipelines that bring ERP data into TransTech’s Microsoft Fabric platform and Power BI reporting. The intended growth path is from ERP data lead into a Senior or Lead Data Engineer or Data Architect role within Data & Analytics, with leadership opportunities also open in ERP and Business Systems, Finance, or Operations.

The ideal candidate has been through at least one full ERP implementation as the person responsible for the data, understands manufacturing and fabrication data end to end (items, BOMs, routings, customers, vendors, inventory, open orders, GL), and combines rigorous attention to detail with the credibility to challenge business owners and the pragmatism to get to a decision. They are equally at home in a modern data engineering toolset: repeatable pipelines and notebooks, Git, an agile backlog, and AI assistants used to move faster without compromising accuracy.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

ERP Data Migration & Readiness:

Serve as TransTech’s data lead for the ERP implementation, owning the data workstream plan, deliverables and readiness gates with the implementation partner and program management.
Extract and profile master and transactional data from legacy systems (SYSPRO, Syteline/CloudSuite Industrial and others), quantifying volumes, completeness, duplication and quality issues by domain.
Build and maintain source-to-target mapping and transformation specifications for each data object (Item/Part, BOM, Routing, Customer, Vendor, Chart of Accounts, Inventory, Open AR/AP, Open Sales and Purchase Orders, Fixed Assets, Employees) against the IFS Cloud data model and load templates.
Design and execute cleansing, de-duplication, standardization and enrichment routines in SQL, Python and Fabric notebooks; track defects to closure with business data owners.
Prepare and execute mock loads, cutover rehearsals and the production cutover; reconcile counts, quantities and financial values to source; run business validation and sign-off; and maintain the data issue log, decision log and cutover checklist.
Support data-related integration requirements between IFS Cloud and surrounding systems (OneStream, Salesforce, Procore, Smartsheet, Fabric).

Master Data Governance

Lead harmonization of Item, Customer and Vendor master data across business units (numbering and naming standards, required attributes, hierarchies, cross-references) and facilitate the cross-BU decisions needed to converge on one standard.
Establish and operate the post-go-live governance model: data ownership and stewardship roles, create/change/retire workflows, approval controls and standards documentation.
Define, measure and publish data quality KPIs by domain and business unit, drive remediation, and act as the enterprise escalation point for master data questions.

Data Engineering & Analytics

Design, build and operate the pipelines that land source-system data in Microsoft Fabric (mirroring, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows, PySpark/SQL notebooks) across Bronze, Silver and Gold layers, including incremental loads, orchestration, monitoring and automated data quality checks.
Build the ERP extracts and Silver/Gold models that replace legacy business-unit reporting after go-live, ensuring continuity of executive and operational Power BI reporting through cutover, and validate that reported figures reconcile to the ERP.
Automate recurring data preparation, validation and reconciliation with SQL, Python/PySpark and Power Query, replacing manual and spreadsheet-based processes with tested, scheduled code.
Apply software engineering practices to data work: Git-based version control in Azure DevOps, pull requests and code review, dev/test/prod promotion, and documentation as code.

Ways Of Working, Training & Documentation

Work within the team’s agile delivery model (user stories, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives in Azure DevOps), breaking migration and governance work into estimable, demonstrable increments.
Use AI tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, AI-assisted coding) as a routine part of profiling, code generation, documentation and analysis, with sound judgment about validating outputs before they are relied on.
Develop and maintain data standards, data dictionaries, mapping documents, runbooks and end-user guides; train and coach business data owners, stewards and analysts; and mentor other members of the Data & Analytics team.

Education And/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Accounting/Finance, Supply Chain or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Five or more years of progressive data analysis, data management or business systems experience in a manufacturing, fabrication, engineered-equipment or industrial services environment.
Hands-on ownership of the data workstream on at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation or migration, including extraction, cleansing, mapping, mock loads, reconciliation and cutover (required).
Strong working knowledge of ERP data structures across manufacturing, supply chain and finance: item/part master, BOMs and routings, customer ship-to/bill-to structures, vendors, inventory and lot/serial data, open orders and GL/sub-ledger balances.
Advanced SQL and Excel required; Python/PySpark and Power Query strongly preferred.
Hands-on experience building data pipelines and lakehouse or warehouse models on Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks or a comparable platform; medallion architecture and Power BI familiarity preferred.
IFS Cloud experience strongly preferred; SYSPRO, Infor Syteline/CloudSuite Industrial, or Infor Visual experience also relevant.
Master data management or data governance experience, and experience consolidating multiple entities, sites or acquired businesses onto a common platform, preferred.
Working knowledge of Git and Azure DevOps (or GitHub/Jira), experience on an agile/scrum team, and demonstrated use of AI assistants in day-to-day analytical and engineering work, preferred.

Personal Attributes

Highest level of integrity and ethics.
Exceptional attention to detail; Strong use of validation to source systems is a must.
Comfortable owning outcomes in an ambiguous, fast-moving program environment with firm deadlines.
Forges strong cross-functional partnerships and drives business owners to timely decisions.
Explains complex data concepts, trade-offs and results clearly to non-technical managers and executives.
Engineering mindset and continuous improvement orientation: prefers repeatable, tested, version-controlled solutions over one-off fixes.
Curious, self-directed learner who adopts new tools quickly, including generative AI, and shares what works with the team.
Works independently with minimal supervision, leads others through change, and interacts effectively at all levels of the organization with a service attitude.

401(k) with generous company match (Safe Harbor)

Job-Hopper is not another job board. It is a candidate-centric platform built for one purpose: to give job seekers a real strategic advantage in their search.

To understand what makes it different, it helps to understand how the rest of the industry works. Legacy job boards are funded by employers. Their revenue comes from companies paying to post openings, so their platforms are built to serve those companies - cutting clutter and saving hiring teams time, while pushing the hard work and frustration onto the job seeker. They are free to apply on, but that is precisely the problem. Reaching the interview stage has become daunting. These boards are crowded with ghost jobs, stale postings, and outright fake listings designed to harvest applicant data.

We hear it every day. Job seekers are spending more time and energy than ever with less to show for it: hours of scrolling and applying, hundreds of submissions, and often not even a call back.

The established recruiting professionals behind Job-Hopper heard this same story from candidate after candidate. Many were strong applicants the traditional recruiting model simply could not place. That gap is what led to Job-Hopper. Development began in early 2025, the platform came to life late that year with the help of many stakeholders, and after an initial launch in 2026 it has been gaining traction and helping job seekers ever since.

Once a listing clears that filter, Job-Hopper matches the best opportunities to each user's profile in real time. Instead of scrolling through endless postings, users are notified the moment a strong match becomes available. The searching and vetting happen in the background, so the candidate can focus only on the opportunities that actually fit.

new_jobs.title: Virtual Care Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Texas Oncology
is looking for a Virtual Care Project Coordinator
to join our team! These positions will support the Virtual Care Program and will work remotely. We are only able to consider candidates across the state of Texas. Typical hours for this position are Mon-Fri from 8a-5p.

Texas Oncology
is the largest community oncology provider in the country and has approximately 600+ providers in 220+ sites across Texas and southeastern Oklahoma. Our founders pioneered community-based cancer care because they believed in making the best available cancer care accessible to all communities, allowing people to fight cancer at home with the critical support of family and friends nearby. Our mission is still the same today—at Texas Oncology, we use leading-edge technology and research to deliver high-quality, high-touch, evidence-based cancer care to help our patients achieve “More breakthroughs. More victories.” ® in their fight against cancer. Today, Texas Oncology
treats half of all Texans diagnosed with cancer on an annual basis.

Why work for us?

Come join our team that is responsible for helping lead Texas Oncology in treating more patient diagnosed with cancer than any other provider in Texas. We offer our employees a competitive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Short-term and Long-term disability coverage, a generous PTO program, a 401k plan that comes with a company match, a Wellness program that rewards you practicing a healthy lifestyle, and lots of other great perks such as Tuition Reimbursement, an Employee Assistance program and discounts on some of your favorite retailers.

What does the Virtual Care Project Coordinator do?

Under direct supervision, performs a wide variety of professional analytical and administrative duties in support of assigned functions for region; performs duties in support of Executive Directors and Regional Practice Directors including special projects, research, budget analysis and other specialized functions; coordinates and performs a variety of activities that support the region. Relies on education, guidelines, policies, and legal requirements to perform responsibilities. Supports and adheres to the US Oncology Compliance Program, to include the Code of Ethics and Business Standards.

Responsibilities

The essential duties and responsibilities:

Perform a wide variety of professional level research, administrative, and analytical duties in support of assigned functions for Executive Directors, Regional Practice Directors and region.
Perform duties in support of various administrative operations and activities within assigned area of responsibility including special projects, research studies, budget analysis, and other specialized functions for region
Participate in the development and implementation of goals, objectives, and priorities for assigned functions; make recommendations for process improvements.
Prepare and present comprehensive technical, administrative, and financial analytical and statistical reports that present and interpret data, identify alternatives, and present and justify conclusions, forecasts, and recommendations based on data summaries and other findings.
Assist ED’s and RPD in the budget development and administration for assigned area of responsibility; maintenance of expenditures; prepare reports and analyses related to impact of budgetary decisions; track and monitor budget expenditures.
Provide assistance in resolving operational and administration issues; identify issues and conduct analyze to find alternative solutions; make and assist in the implementation of recommendations.
Coordinate, implement, and monitor special projects within assigned area of responsibility; perform complex research and analysis of new procedures; prepare and present reports relative to processes.
Plan, coordinate, and evaluate activities associated with assigned duties; participate in meetings and evaluation of proposed recommendations; assist in putting measurements in place and monitor compliance
Coordinate, prepare, and conduct marketing and outreach programs; prepare marketing material including brochures, posters, articles, advertisements, flyers, schedules of events, and pamphlets; attend and participate in community groups and meetings; educate the public on assigned programs.
Provide staff assistance to higher-level management staff; participate on and provide staff support to a variety of committees; prepare and present staff reports and other correspondence as appropriate and necessary.
Coordinate and collaborate with departments, divisions and outside agencies; serve as a liaison to assist region with obtaining information and serves as a resource.
Respond to inquiries in a courteous manner; provide information within the area of assignment; resolve complaints in an efficient and timely manner.
Perform related duties as required.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate for the Virtual Care Project Coordinator will have the following background and experience:

Bachelor’s degree preferred; college course work in business administration or relevant equivalent required.
Proficiency with computer systems and MicroSoft Office (Outlook, Word, Power Point, and Excel) required.
Perform a full range of responsible analytical and administrative duties in support of assigned functions, and region involving the use of independent judgment and personal initiative.
Research and analyze problems and prepare recommendations on a variety of issues.
Understand the organization and operation of assigned department and outside agencies as necessary to assume assigned responsibilities.
Collect, evaluate and interpret complex information and data.
Maintain accurate and complete records on programs and operations.
Assist with budget preparation and administration.
Independently prepare correspondence and memoranda.
Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

Competencies

Uses Technical and Functional Experience: Possesses up to date knowledge of the profession and industry; is regarded a san expert in the technical/functional area; accesses and uses other expert resources when appropriate.
Demonstrates Adaptability: Handles day to day work challenges confidently; is willing and able to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change; shows resilience inn the face of constraints, frustrations, or adversity; demonstrates flexibility.
Uses Sound Judgment: Makes timely, cost effective and sound decisions; makes decisions under conditions of uncertainty.
Shows Work Commitment: Sets high standards of performance; pursues aggressive goals and works efficiently to achieve them.
Commits to Quality: Emphasizes the need to deliver quality products and/or services; defines standards for quality and evaluated products, processes, and service against those standards; manages quality; improves efficiencies.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to be present at the employee site during regularly scheduled business hours and regularly required to sit or stand and talk or hear. Requires full range of body motion including handling and lifting patients, manual and finger dexterity, and eye-hand coordination. Requires standing and walking for extensive periods of time. Occasionally lifts and carries items weighing up to 40 lbs. Requires corrected vision and hearing to normal range.

Working Conditions

The work environment may include exposure to communicable diseases, toxic substances, ionizing radiation, medical preparations and other conditions common to an oncology/hematology clinic environment. Work will involve virtual interaction with co-workers and management and/or clients.

new_jobs.title: Pickleball Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Entrada at Snow Canyon Country Club
, located in St. George, UT,
is pleased to announce an excellent career opportunity for a Pickleball Program Coordinator
! We are seeking a driven individual who is eager to learn, contribute, and grow within a fast‑paced hospitality-focused property organization. As part of Troon, you’ll contribute to a global leader in golf and community management.

Welcome to Entrada at Snow Canyon Country Club, an exclusive, members-only full-service private club in beautiful St. George, Utah, where only the best food, finest cocktails and superior service is delivered among an amazing championship golf course, a resort-inspired pool, and state of the art fitness center. Joining our team not only provides you with unparalleled career opportunities, but it is also the place where you will connect and be surrounded by other talented hospitality professionals like yourself, working together to create memorable experiences for our members and their guests. The atmosphere is refined, the music is lively, and the comradery is personal – there’s nowhere else you’d rather be.

Our Pickleball Program Coordinator provides leadership to an important function that creates and executes a growing and dynamic pickleball program to our members, prospective members and guests. Under the leadership of the Director of Fitness, this role promotes high-level hospitality to members and their guests and organizes and implements all racquet activities with the goal of enhancing the image and member experience of Entrada at Snow Canyon Country Club.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Create a welcoming, energetic atmosphere through high-quality pickleball open play, leagues, social events, and tournaments for players of all skill levels.
Foster engagement, build community, and promote participation while supporting daily court operations and delivering outstanding hospitality.
Responsible for the programming of all racquet activities.
Responsible for administering all areas and functions of the tennis and pickleball programs, including social events, classes, clinics, lessons, training, special events, and tournaments.
Executes all daily operations of the Club’s racquet program, including opening and closing procedures.
Assist members with court reservations, lesson registrations, and program inquiries.
Responsible for implementing and maintaining excellent racquet service and managing member relationships to achieve exceptional member satisfaction.
Perform necessary administrative tasks, such as attendance taking, returning messages, and general correspondence with patrons and co-workers.
Success will be measured by program growth, member and guest satisfaction, and the creation of a fun, active pickleball culture that enhances the club experience.
Responsible for managing the proper care, maintenance and cleanliness of outdoor courts and related equipment.
Works with members, Wellness Committee and Director of Fitness to implement and adjust policies and procedures.
Responsible for evaluating performance of racquet programs and addressing complaints and resolving problems.
Coordinate effectively with department team members that may include teaching professionals, front desk, weekend supervisor, fitness trainers / instructors and spa therapists.
Work with other departments to achieve member service and communication objectives regarding club activities and events.
Respond to time-sensitive matters including member queries and incident responses.
Maintain strictest of confidence in sensitive matters pertaining to members and/or associates. Privy to information that is not to be shared.
Effective team member offering solutions and suggestions to membership complaints, issues, facility challenges and overall ways to better enhance service, a hospitality culture and the overall Club culture.
Able to utilize rational judgment and discretion to ensure members' overall satisfaction with no or minimum supervision in day-to-day operations.
Uses diplomacy whenever interacting or handling complaints from members.
Ensure online calendars, bulletin boards, and/or other communication means are kept up to date.
Promote and support racquet social events, lessons, clinics, leagues, camps, and tournaments.
Enforce guest policies and support Wellness Center programming.
Performs other duties as required and self-initiated as part of the team culture.
Flexible availability including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Regular and reliable attendance.
Professional appearance and demeanor suitable for a private club environment.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

Associate’s degree (AA) in Physical Education or related field; or six months to one year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Frequently talks and hears. Frequently uses hands; reaches with hands and arms; talks, hears, stands and walks, climbs or balances; stoops, and kneels. Occasionally sits, crouches, or crawls; tastes or smells. Occasionally lifts up to 45 pounds.

ENVIRONMENT/NOISE:

Occasionally works in outdoor weather conditions. Noise level is moderate.

CERTIFICATES/LICENSES:

USAPA certification (or equivalent). AED, CPR and First Aid.

JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILL, AND ABILITY PREFERENCES:

Ability to read and speak English may be required in order to perform the duties of the job (e.g. the associate may be required to communicate with English speaking customers or co-workers, the manuals for the equipment the associate may use are in English).
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Products (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word).
Driven individual who is eager to learn, contribute, and grow within a fast paced hospitality-focused property organization.
Service driven, highly organized, knowledgeable in racquet sports, and thrives in a private club setting.
Outstanding communication skills – written and verbal – are required to interact with members, senior leadership, other departments, outside agencies/vendors and colleagues.
Independent thinker with outstanding time management skills –ability to manage priorities and schedules that change on a daily basis.
Strong communication skills and proficient knowledge of company policies and procedures.
Available for evenings, weekends and holidays as needed.
Friendly and outgoing, shows a passion for pickleball.
Strong organizational skills: time management, attention to detail, ability to self-start. Strong work ethic.

Benefits & Other Compensation:

This position includes eligibility for the following benefits, subject to applicable plan terms:

Healthcare Benefits – Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
Retirement Benefits – 401(k) with employer match (19 years of age and older)

Eligibility for benefits and the specific terms, conditions, and offerings are governed by the applicable plan of documents and company policies, which may be amended at the Company’s discretion.

About Troon

Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ, Troon is the world’s largest professional club management company, that specializes in services in golf, hospitality, and residential communities. With more than 900 locations in 45+ states and 27+ countries, Troon is a leading employer in hospitality. Guided by values that emphasize being infectiously energetic, consciously kind, and humbly prosperous, Troon offers professionals the opportunity to grow and succeed within a globally respected organization. Learn more at www.troon.com.
